# latching_food_box — articulation audit

**ARTCHECK status: FAIL.** The mechanical repair and exports are complete, but the requested physical-evidence and 10-pixel alignment gates are not satisfied. No `ARTCHECK_DONE` marker is issued.

[Numerical report](../artcheck_report.json) · [photo / render / overlay](../review/artcheck_latching_food_box.jpg) · [interactive local review](../review/artcheck/index.html) · [synchronized sparse video](../review/artcheck/reconstruction_replay.mp4).

## Scope and evidence

The set contains 28 primary dishware types and eight reusable variants. This is the only constrained articulated asset: four revolute clip joints, with their original names retained. The container and removable lid remain independent bodies. Unconstrained removable lids and straws are not invented hinges. The oven and cabinet fronts are outside this set.

Cross-referenced `IMG_1311.MOV`, the registered photographs, current `Scene` calibration, inventory entries `dish_storage_box_01`–`03`, `articulation.json`, and `splat_art/joint_states.json`. Neither joint dataset contains these clips. Reviewed the whole source at 5-second intervals and 43–105 seconds at 1-second intervals, plus the three native-resolution registered close-ups f2965, f2979 and f2980. This is sampled video inspection, not an exhaustive native-frame analysis. The boxes are not handled in the reviewed intervals; the front clip is already open. The rear leaves are occluded. The side leaf overlaps blurred transparent rim edges.

Metric scale comes from the supplied scene reconstruction, not a physical ruler. OpenCV cameras use 1280×1707 pixels. Source time is frame index / 30. All evaluation is offline. Two front-patch depth-plane measurements are retained under `review/artcheck/depth_front_*.json`; their normals disagree and are not used as a 5 mm hinge-anchor measurement.

## What was wrong and what changed

- The old 6 mm clips intersected the shell. MuJoCo measured a maximum **3.100 mm** penetration with parent–child contacts enabled.
- Replaced the slabs with separate thin molded-flap surrogates outside the shell. Thickness is a **0.5 mm modeling prior**, not a product measurement. The photographed long flap motivated a width of 55% of the long body dimension; free-edge taper is inferred. Hinges sit on the upper inside leaf edges and positive q opens outward. Unresolved living-hinge webs are omitted rather than assigned unmeasured stiffness.
- The build spec held the preceding world coordinate frame while `model.json` had current poses. Synchronized spec instances and cameras to the current calibration before fitting. The old rigid instance up-axis tilt was **2.757°**; repaired instance pitch and roll are zero.
- Corrected yaw from **-33.921°** to **-92.968°**, then fitted translation and scale with the supplied cameras fixed. This is an in-sample fit, not independent validation.
- Nonuniform scale now applies to rest geometry and hinge origins before rotation. The old scale-after-rotation behavior stretched opening clips. `joint_q` and a documented legacy affine `part_transforms` equivalent are regenerated by `build.py`; importers must preserve this order.
- Regenerated `parts/`, `collision/`, `model.glb`, `model.blend`, `model.json`, and added `model.xml` and `model.urdf`. Existing textures remain. Front is `[0,1,0]`; preferred view is azimuth 90°, elevation 25°, with azimuth measured from asset +X toward +Y.

## Measured checks

| Joint | Rigid pose tilt | Max instance face offset | Max full-edge gap | Literal all-edge orientation | Collision sweep |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| latch_0_hinge | 0.000° | 2.593 mm | 1.999 mm | FAIL: tapered side 15.70° | PASS |
| latch_1_hinge | 0.000° | 2.593 mm | 1.999 mm | FAIL: tapered side 15.70° | PASS |
| latch_2_hinge | 0.000° | 2.565 mm | 2.018 mm | FAIL: tapered side 10.97° | PASS |
| latch_3_hinge | 0.000° | 2.565 mm | 2.018 mm | FAIL: tapered side 10.97° | PASS |

The rigid leaf planes are upright and their hinge/free edges horizontal. Clearance and face-offset tests pass. The inferred tapered side cuts are diagonal; the literal requirement that *every* visible straight edge be vertical/horizontal is therefore recorded as FAIL rather than silently excluded. The photo evidence does not establish a rectangular untapered leaf with the requested precision.

Each hinge was swept through ten endpoint-inclusive positions. Additional synchronized openings and all open/closed combinations bring the canonical total to **66 configurations**. The same 66 configurations were tested at each of the three instance scales, **264 configurations total**, with no negative contact distance beyond the **1 µm numerical tolerance**. Contact masks remain enabled, including parent–child pairs. This is a finite kinematic contact audit; elastic snapping, continuous collision and assembled-stack dynamics are not certified.

| Frame | Front-flap maximum corner error | Complete stack silhouette maximum edge error |
|---|---:|---:|
| f2965 | 32.29 px | 30.41 px |
| f2979 | 19.37 px | 39.20 px |
| f2980 | 22.86 px | 40.20 px |

These exceed the **10 px** threshold. Manual front-corner uncertainty is approximately **8 px**. The report retains exact pixels, predictions and image-plane metric equivalents. No per-frame camera adjustment or image registration was applied. Diagnostic opaque colors make transparent part boundaries legible; the GLB retains its original optical materials and textures.

The visible front leaf is fitted at **0.929812 rad** in all three views of the same static state. Other leaf states remain explicitly unmeasured 1.3 rad assumptions. There are **zero observed actuation frames** for any clip. The physical 2° axis/5 mm anchor tests, observed maximum opening, and physical stop are unknown and FAIL. The existing range **[0, 1.7] rad** is retained as an unverified simulation prior; collision-free travel does not measure a real stop.

## Contact and physical model

The body has a segmented convex floor/wall shell preserving its cavity; the lid and four leaves have separate contacts. **54 contact pieces** pass watertightness/convexity checks. MJCF has two free roots (body and lid), and the clips are children of the lid. URDF uses a floating lid joint. No artificial fixed attachment closes the removable lid.

Canonical empty mass is **0.200788 kg**, integrated from closed shells with the retained **950 kg/m³** polymer density prior. Inertias, center of mass and all instance masses were recomputed. Nominal ±30% mass and friction 0.3 remain assumptions. The exports add conservative 0.0002 N·m·s/rad hinge damping and a URDF effort limit of 0.05 N·m, neither measured. No elastic latch detent, friction experiment, fatigue, fracture, food contents or grasp validation is implied.

GLB/OBJ bounds agree, all four joint axes/anchors agree between JSON, MJCF and URDF, and scaled-instance rotations are orthonormal. See [format validation](../review/artcheck/format_validation.json). The set indices now point to the repaired instance poses. Historical appearance/settling reports and the aggregate placement scene predate this repair; use the current per-asset files and articulation review for this result.

## Reproduce

From the repository root, prefix each CPU command with `nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19`. Set `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`.

1. `QA_FAST=1 blender -b -t 4 --python-exit-code 1 -P scenes/kitchen_1/gpt6/assets/dishware/latching_food_box/build.py`
2. `.venv-sim/bin/python scenes/kitchen_1/gpt6/assets/dishware/artcheck_validate.py`
3. `blender -b -t 4 --python-exit-code 1 -P scenes/kitchen_1/gpt6/assets/dishware/artcheck_render.py`
4. Run `artcheck_report.py`, `artcheck_package.py`, and `artcheck_document.py` with the scene Python environment.

`artcheck_fit.py` is the historical fit, not a required rebuild step. The authoritative fitted spec is retained. Review video uses `review/artcheck/video_frames/%04d.jpg` at one sampled source view per second; timestamps printed on the panels preserve the source times. Final five-image rendering took **22.951 s** with 16 CPU samples and four threads. No online speed claim is made.

Original asset notes and geometry are retained in `review/artcheck/before/latching_food_box/`.
